        u = int(next(iterator))
        v = int(next(iterator))
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)
    
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    def dfs(u, p):
        sz = 1
        dp[u][0] = 1
        
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v == p:

                    term = (term1 + term2) % MOD
                    new_dp_u[i + j] = (new_dp_u[i + j] + term) % MOD
